newsitem.title: GREECE: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK PICKS NEW BOARD CHMN.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK PICKS NEW BOARD CHMN.

text.p: The board of directors of Macedonia-Thrace Bank picked Spyros Kouniakis, former deputy governor of state National Bank as its new chairman, it said on Monday.
The bank's board said it also accepted the resignation of former board chairman Andreas Boumis and board member Haris Stamatopoulos.
Replacing Stamatopoulos will be new board member Dimitris Pavlakis, managing director of NIBID , the bank said.
Kouniakis is an experienced banker with studies in economics, political science and law, Macedonia Thrace Bank said.

He was previously a vice-president with Halkis Cements, Siemens Tele Industrie SA and a member of the board of directors of National Mortgage Bank , South African Bank of Athens and Ethnofact SA. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
